{
  "candidate_rtl": "module adder #(parameter N = 32) (
    input [N-1:0] DATA_1,
    input [N-1:0] DATA_2,
    input SEL_0,
    input SEL_1,
    input clk,
    output reg [N-1:0] reg_0
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (N + 3) / 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);

    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] prefix_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] prefix_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [N-1:0] sum;
    wire select_sum = SEL_0 & ~SEL_1;
    wire select_data1 = ~SEL_0 & ~SEL_1;
    wire [N-1:0] next_value;

    genvar b, j, level, k;
    generate
        for (b = 0; b < BLOCKS; b = b + 1) begin : block_adder
            wire [3:0] p;
            wire [3:0] g;
            wire [3:0] c;

            for (j = 0; j < 4; j = j + 1) begin : bit_inputs
                if (4*b+j < N) begin : valid_bit
                    assign p[j] = DATA_1[4*b+j] | DATA_2[4*b+j];
                    assign g[j] = DATA_1[4*b+j] & DATA_2[4*b+j];
                    assign sum[4*b+j] = DATA_1[4*b+j] ^ DATA_2[4*b+j] ^ c[j];
                end else begin : padding
                    assign p[j] = 1'b1;
                    assign g[j] = 1'b0;
                end
            end

            assign prefix_p[0][b] = &p;
            assign prefix_g[0][b] = g[3]
                | (p[3] & g[2])
                | (p[3] & p[2] & g[1])
                | (p[3] & p[2] & p[1] & g[0]);

            if (b == 0) begin : first_block
                assign c[0] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : later_block
                assign c[0] = prefix_g[LEVELS][b-1];
            end
            assign c[1] = g[0] | (p[0] & c[0]);
            assign c[2] = g[1] | (p[1] & g[0])
                | (p[1] & p[0] & c[0]);
            assign c[3] = g[2] | (p[2] & g[1])
                | (p[2] & p[1] & g[0])
                | (p[2] & p[1] & p[0] & c[0]);
        end

        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_level
            for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin : prefix_node
                if (k >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][k] = prefix_g[level][k]
                        | (prefix_p[level][k] & prefix_g[level][k-(1 << level)]);
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][k] = prefix_p[level][k]
                        & prefix_p[level][k-(1 << level)];
                end else begin : pass_through
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][k] = prefix_g[level][k];
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][k] = prefix_p[level][k];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign next_value = (sum & {N{select_sum}})
                      | (DATA_1 & {N{select_data1}})
                      | (DATA_2 & {N{SEL_1}});

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        reg_0 <= next_value;
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The supplied critical paths traverse substantial carry-related combinational logic before the output register, with additional selection logic near the endpoint. The measured baseline WNS is 8.39 ns; precise source-to-cell correspondence is not available.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit four-bit carry-lookahead blocks connected by a balanced group-prefix network. OR-based carry propagation avoids requiring an initial XOR on the carry-generation path. Flatten the two output selections into three mutually exclusive masked terms, preserving SEL_1 priority.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended benefit is reduced carry dependency depth and a shallower final selection cone. At N=32, the group-prefix network has three combining levels. No improvement is claimed as measured; synthesis and STA under the fixed settings must establish whether WNS exceeds 8.39 ns.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Explicit prefix logic can increase wiring, fanout, and mapped area, although unused prefix nodes can be removed by synthesis. The candidate must be checked against the fixed 3406.392 um^2 area cap and the existing electrical checks; neither area nor timing acceptance is established here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, parameter, native unsigned ports, output width, and single positive-edge register stage. No reset, enable, state, startup assumption, or extra latency is introduced. For positive N, addition remains modulo 2^N, including non-multiples of four. SEL_1 selects DATA_2 regardless of SEL_0; otherwise SEL_0 selects the sum or DATA_1. Formal and mapped equivalence must be checked against the frozen original under the unchanged startup contract."
}
